seasonRead.headline: 2019–20: Transition and possession offer two paths into attack
paragraphs: Rush / Transition Chance Creator and High-Touch Puck Mover form the clearest tactical poles in the interrupted season: create in motion or hold the puck long enough to extend the sequence.

Interior Net-Front Finisher fills the space between them, but its name should not be treated as proof of constant crease work; the interior signal is modest here. The stronger roster read is that transport, possession and finishing responsibility were distributed across different players.

seasonRead.headline: 2019–20: The blue line is almost a binary choice
paragraphs: Play-Driving Puck-Moving Defenseman and Shot-Blocking Defensive Defenseman create one of the cleanest stylistic splits in the dataset. One is associated with distribution and favorable team chances; the other with blocks and lower point involvement.

Physical Shutdown Defenseman adds a smaller, more confrontational lane. The pairing question is how much puck-advancement responsibility to place beside a defender whose statistical identity is built around blocks and contact.
